articles.title: Update of 15.12.2025
articles.summary: Fixed the VSSM, level transitions and stashes; added the ASH-12 and hand tessellation.
articles.content:
• Fixed the VSSM position
• Restored the Radar–Warehouses transition
• Fixed Caesar’s stash locations
• Added the ASH-12 assault rifle and Falke LE red dot sight
• Removed the ADAR carbine and Kemper red dot sight
• Moved the transition from Yantar to Agroprom earlier in the story
• Added tessellation for hands

articles.title: Update of 16.12.2025
articles.summary: Fixed crashes, camera collision and lighting; updated DLSS Transformer.
articles.content:
• Fixed a crash related to the assault Abakan
• Fixed camera collision
• Fixed lighting after changing the shadow map size
• Fixed settings reflection being disabled
• Moved debugging features to Dev mode
• Reduced lens zoom
• Updated DLSS Transformer to version 310.4.0

articles.title: Update of 17.12.2025
articles.summary: Fixed M32 spawning and TOZ collision, and updated lighting; added animations and dialogue.
articles.content:
• Fixed M32 spawning
• Fixed TOZ collision
• Reduced hemi lighting
• Added aiming start and end animations
• Added dialogue about the baker after Sidorovich leaves for the Cordon

articles.title: Update of 19.12.2025
articles.summary: Fixed aiming and sound; added a radial menu for the detector and pistol.
articles.content:
• Fixed aiming with the VSSM and Prince’s AK-12
• Fixed quest status sounds overlapping the protagonist’s gunfire
• Fixed sector resets after loading a save in the same location
• Added the option to draw the detector and pistol from the radial menu
• Updated suppressed 9×18 pistol shot sounds

articles.title: Update of 21.12.2025
articles.summary: Added in-game tutorials and alternative key bindings; fixed mutants, quests and saves.
articles.content:
• Fixed auto-aim for some mutants: snorks, dogs and spiders
• Fixed key names
• Fixed the restrictor in Sviblov’s bloodsucker quest
• Fixed corpse cleanup in Dark Valley involving the eighth stash map
• Added alternative key bindings
• Added an in-game tutorial module
• Added a menu button linking to OGSR Org
• Moved news to the bottom of the screen
• Fixed aiming being retained when the player saved

articles.title: Update of 24.12.2025
articles.summary: Added the G36 and emission shelters; fixed weapons, quests, stashes and interface.
articles.content:
• Fixed the MP-153 magazine ammo count
• Fixed food and medicine animations getting stuck in some cases
• Adjusted Lukash’s position after returning to base
• Fixed the map icon and guide part icons
• Fixed artifact crafting
• Fixed scoped aiming with the VSSM
• Fixed some key bindings missing on first launch
• Fixed a crash caused by the marker for the bandit stash in Dark Valley
• Added “equipped” text to the pistol repair window
• Fixed the scientist corpse with a map being removed at Glubokoye Station
• Fixed the safe in the Red Forest mine
• Added emission shelters in Dead City
• Added the G36: Lukash now gives it instead of the Remington R5
• Increased compass marker visibility range

articles.title: Update of 27.12.2025
articles.summary: Added volume controls, fixed weapons and quests, and adjusted damage balance.
articles.content:
• Fixed missing particles on the flamethrower, Gauss rifle and anomalous Groza
• Fixed an NPC crash related to the Mosin rifle
• Fixed localization
• Fixed the parrots at Bar checkpoints repeating one line until the entry fee is paid
• Fixed the “Good Ending”
• Fixed G36 safe mode and its post-update state (to repair it, move the weapon to any available inventory slot)
• Fixed ammo type switching on the Saiga, DVL, SV-98 and Remington 700
• Added separate volume sliders for master, interface, weapons, music and other effects
• Added a phosphor stick near Krol’s journal
• Added NPC Snickers containing a fragment of Semetsky’s map
• Added dynamic anomaly spawn restriction zones in Pripyat and Glubokoye Station
• Added item quantities received and handed over to the dialogue window
• Adjusted damage: DVL +0.15; FN FAL +0.05; G28 −0.2; MDR +0.1; Remington 700 +0.1; SVD +0.2

articles.title: Update of 30.12.2025
articles.summary: Added the MTs-255 revolver shotgun and updated animations and models; fixed music and spawning.
articles.content:
• Radio music volume now follows the music volume slider
• Fixed infinite mutant respawning
• Fixed the magician quest: Ghost once again returns the stolen items to the protagonist
• Fixed missing tessellation on dynamic objects that support it
• Added zoom memory for variable-magnification scopes
• Added the MTs-255 revolver shotgun
• Removed the VZ Scorpion: Caesar’s stash now contains an MTs-255, while NPCs carry an MP5
• Updated impact grenade animations
• Updated first-person character leg models

articles.title: Update of 03.01.2026
articles.summary: Fixed crashes and infinite spawning; updated volumetric lighting and Mosin rifle sounds.
articles.content:
• Fixed a crash when approaching Sidor’s village at Glubokoye Station
• Fixed unlimited mob spawning at locations
• Fixed the RPK-16 magazine ammo count
• Fixed a crash after calming the Professor in X-10 and corrected his logic
• Removed spider spawning after talking to the Professor
• Added a spent cartridge layout in the MTs-255 cylinder
• Added the missing Mosin rifle sound and updated its sounds
• Updated volumetric lighting for a better look and lower FPS cost

articles.title: Update of 08.01.2026
articles.summary: Fixed settings, voice-over, flamethrower and artifact spawning; added English localization.

• Fixed Clear Sky voice-over
• Fixed the flamethrower refill by Shurup
• Fixed mutant part spawning in anomalies
• Adjusted mutant part prices, quest item weights and some rewards
